format: Original transparent PNG atlases, 4 columns × 4 rows, 16 consecutive cels. Generated pixels preserved without post-editing.

render.placement: Above selected lyric glyphs, within the selected group; quiet decoration smaller than text.
render.lightning: Reused approved bolt, up to .52 lyric height at 95% opacity, constrained to its cloud span. Two cel-animation bursts (140 ms and 260 ms) per 1600 ms make the discharge recognizable. Reduced motion retains a static bolt at about 81% opacity. The storm preset icon uses the lightning sheet to distinguish it from clouds without thunder.

reuse: One canonical bitmap per white cloud, overcast cloud, sun and bird. Reuse rain-v1.png and lightning.png. Canvas image identity and export payloads are shared by content ID; unused components are excluded.

EXACTLY 16 independently drawn consecutive animation cels in a regular 4 by 4 grid of square cells. One subject per cell, no visible grid/labels. Animation: sixteen actual drawings of its lobes softly billowing and gently changing fullness, a small lobe developing then folding into the body; the overall center and size remain stable. Calm and light, not bouncing.
Exactly three flat color regions: soft white #f7fbff on top, cool pale #d8e6ef body, small understated #a8becf underside. Minimal detail, contemporary professional game cel artwork.
